"'''Mystery of the Opal Cave / Clash'''" is the sixteenth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[November 8]], [[2023]].<ref name=" More YJA Episodes2" />

==Official description==
''Jedi explore haunted cave. Kai and a rival team up.''
